dimensions.assessment: Affects holders of geothermal leases on federal lands and federal agencies responsible for land management and environmental reviews.
dimensions.evidence: Geothermal exploration projects and covered activities shall not be considered major Federal actions under section 102(2)(C) of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969

dimensions.assessment: Streamlines geothermal exploration by removing environmental review requirements for qualifying wells and access road activities under active leases.
dimensions.evidence: Geothermal exploration projects and covered activities shall not be considered major Federal actions under section 102(2)(C) of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state any federal spending or revenue changes.
Amends the Geothermal Steam Act of 1970 to create statutory exemptions from NEPA for specific categories of exploratory drilling and access road maintenance.
dimensions.evidence: The Geothermal Steam Act of 1970 (30 U.S.C. 1001 et seq.) is amended by adding at the end the following: ``SEC. 30. GEOTHERMAL EXPLORATION PROJECTS.''

dimensions.assessment: Permanently amends the Geothermal Steam Act to provide ongoing NEPA exemptions for qualifying geothermal exploration projects.
